title: A metal injection molding entrepreneur just gave his old college its largest-ever single gift
sources: IIT Madras (institute press release) - IIT Madras gets largest single donation Rs 228 crore
WION - IIT Madras gets historic Rs 228 crore donation from alumnus
caption:
A metal injection molding entrepreneur just gave his old college its largest-ever single gift. Rs 228 crore - the biggest donation IIT Madras has ever received.

Dr. Krishna Chivukula, a 1970 IIT Madras graduate who founded Indo-MIM - now the world's largest metal injection molding company by capacity and sales - donated Rs 228 crore to his alma mater. The gift funds fellowships for top BTech students, sportspersons, foreign students and high-risk faculty research. IIT Madras named an academic building the Krishna Chivukula Block in his honour.

Most alumni gifts fund a scholarship or two. This one got an entire building named after the donor.
